in_marathi.name: Sooraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sooraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sooraj is derived from the Sanskrit word Surya, which means 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Sooraj is the name of the Sun God. This name signifies radiance, strength, and power, and is a reminder of the life-giving force of the sun.
